name: Shree Precoated Steels Limited
about: Shree Precoated Steels Limited engages in the real estate business in India. It also manufactures, processes, and trades in steel products. In addition, the company focuses on the real estate development and redevelopment projects. Further, it trades in flats and development rights; and invests in real estate. The company was formerly known as Ajmera Precoated Steels Limited and changed its name to Shree Precoated Steels Limited in April 2009. Shree Precoated Steels Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mumbai, India.
